The '''74-M speeder bike''' was a type of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] that was made by the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]] and used during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Some were used in the [[Geddis mine]] on [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] to transport miners about.
